fact: The UNDP consultancy notice for the Ministry of Health states that the ministry has used DHIS2 as South Sudan's electronic health information management system since 2018 and that it has been scaled up to all counties and some selected health facilities; the notice dates from early 2021.
title: DHIS2 International Consultant for South Sudan Ministry of Health - Juba, SOUTH SUDAN
publisher: UNDP, on the United Nations Global Marketplace
